welcome.title: Welcome to Harbor
welcome.text: A work and study tool for social rehabilitation educators and addiction specialists. Choose a language – you can change it at any time in settings.
welcome.offline: Harbor works 100% offline. Nothing is sent to the internet – your data stays on this device only.

password.title: Set a password
password.text: The password encrypts all data (AES-256). You will enter it every time you open the app and after automatic locking.
password.label: Password or PIN (min. 6 characters)
password.hint: A few words or a longer phrase works best.
password.strength1: Weak – make it longer or more varied
password.lossText: There is no way to recover the password and no back door. Keep it somewhere safe and make regular backups.
password.ack: I understand that I cannot recover my data without the password.
password.ackRequired: Please confirm that you understand how the password works.
password.tooShort: The password must have at least 6 characters.

modules.title: What's inside
modules.text: One consistent space for working with many people, designing prevention and studying.

clients.title: {{Clients}}
clients.text: Educational assessment, individual plan, relapse prevention plan, timeline, genogram.

tools.title: Tools to use together
tools.text: Urge surfing, readiness ruler, chain analysis, HALT and more.

prevention.title: Prevention
prevention.text: Prevention programme builder with evaluation and PDF export.

modules.disclaimer: Harbor supports work and study. It does not make medical diagnoses or decisions on behalf of a professional – all indicators and suggestions are supportive only.

mode.title: Where do you start?
mode.text: The two modes are completely separate.
mode.demoText: Fictional, realistic case studies – ideal for classes, placements and presenting at university.
mode.practiceText: Real work – an empty, encrypted space for the people you work with.
mode.changeLater: You can switch mode at any time in the header or in settings.

countryHint: It determines the help system, legal basis, crisis numbers and training cases. Independent of the language – you can change it in Settings.
